title: Bar Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Pineapple Ice from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection is like your own portable tropical getaway. Each puff is a mini-holiday, filled with the sunny sweetness of ripe pineapples. It’s as if you’ve just plucked a pineapple straight from a tropical palm tree, one that’s bursting with juiciness and sun-soaked flavour. But just as you think you’re lost in paradise, a cool, icy undertone sweeps in, giving you the sensation of sipping a frozen pineapple cocktail by the beach. It's a complex yet well-balanced 10ml nic salt e-liquid that gives you both the juicy heat of the tropics and the coolness of a fresh winter breeze. If you’ve adored similar flavours found in disposable vapes, then you’ll absolutely swoon for Pineapple Ice from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection of 10ml Nic Salt e-liquids with non-disposable vapes. This premium e-liquid boasts a 50VG/50PG ratio, expertly balancing flavour and vapour. Perfect for starter kits and pod systems, its nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth, gratifying throat hit—especially ideal for those fresh off cigarettes. Nicotine Salt E-liquids are absorbed swiftly, making them a great choice for immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Looking for something a bit different? Check out the Bar Salts collection by Vampire Vape, featuring many other exciting flavours like Cherry Ice, Blue Sour Raspberry and Pineapple Ice. These 10ml e-liquids can be used in starter kits and pod kits and they allow you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer than a 2ml disposable vape device, all while reducing plastic waste. And because they share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable cousins, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver all the satisfying relief from nicotine cravings along with a super-smooth throat hit for comfortable, effective and enjoyable all-day vaping.
